gizmo.title: Kēmu mahere huatau
gizmo.description: He kēmu papapātuhi poto. Ka hīkoi tētahi kiripuaki ki ia huatau o te mahere ka whakamārama taua huatau i a ia anō. Pāhia katoa kia whiwhi i te kōpaka me tētahi tohutohu hei tāruatanga.

configure.title: Mahi
configure.description: Te tohutohu e whakaaturia ana ki te mata tīmatanga. Whakaaturia ki te kaitākaro te take o te haerenga.

configure.title: Ngā huatau
configure.description: He tapawhā i te mahere ia huatau.

configure.title: Tapanga pokapū
configure.description: Te whakaaro e tutuki ai ngā huatau katoa.

configure.title: Ā muri i te kēmu
configure.description: Kōwhiringa anake. Ka whakakapia te pouaka tārua tohutohu o te papa whakamutunga ki tāu ake ihirangi, pēnei i tētahi hīkoinga e whai ake nei, i tētahi hononga rānei.

configure.title: Ētahi atu pātene ā muri i te kēmu
configure.description: Kōwhiringa anake. Ngā pātene, ngā hononga rānei e whakaaturia ana i te taha o Tākaro anō i te papa whakamutunga.

advanced.title: Kakano kiripuaki
advanced.description: He kuputuhi tahi noa. Ka hanga tonu te kakano ōrite i te kiripuaki ōrite. Koinei te kakano ōrite e whakamahia ana e te hoahoa kanohi o HAX.

advanced.title: Whakamahia te kiripuaki o te tangata kua takiuru
advanced.description: Ka takiuru tētahi ki HAX, ka rite te kiripuaki ki tōna ake hoahoa kanohi. Ka kite ētahi atu i te kakano i runga ake nei.

advanced.title: Rārangi i runga i te tohutohu
advanced.description: Waiho kia kau mō te rārangi taunoa.

advanced.title: Tohutohu hei tāruatanga
advanced.description: E whakaaturia ana ki te papa whakamutunga me tētahi pātene tārua. Whakawātea kia huna ai te pouaka.

advanced.title: Ingoa kēmu
advanced.description: Ka tapaina tēnei kēmu i ngā takahanga ahunga whakamua me te tohu OER Schema.

advanced.title: Tohu kēmu
advanced.description: Kōwhiringa anake. Ka wehewehe i tēnei kēmu i ētahi atu o te whārangi i ngā takahanga ahunga whakamua.
